task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in Paris and get any weather alerts for the city, then pull up the booking sheet for the Hilton Tokyo and publish it to my app with high priority. After that, analyze the text "Hilton Tokyo Available at 180 USD/night" and find me a meeting room for 4 people on May 20th, 2026.
